rules: Long on confirmed LL only if RSI(14) at the confirming close is below 32. Exit at +TP% (on candle high) or a confirmed HH, whichever comes first. LH is ignored at all times. Short is the mirror: enter on HH only if RSI(14) is above 68, TP on candle low, exit only on a confirmed LL. HL is ignored at all times. No stop-loss. One position per coin. Reverse if an opposite entry confirms on the same candle as an exit and RSI also confirms that entry (HH closes a long and may open a short; LL is the mirror).
